# `.github/`

- [`dependabot.yml`](dependabot.yml): weekly grouped updates for
  `github-actions` and `uv`, both rooted at `/`.
- [`workflows/ci.yml`](workflows/ci.yml): the two CI jobs described in
  [`workflows/README.md`](workflows/README.md).

Contributor gates and repository rules are in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
